query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  office_id INT NOT NULL,
  client_id INT,
  client_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  client_email VARCHAR(255),
  client_phone VARCHAR(20),
  client_address TEXT,
  issue_date DATE NOT NULL,
  due_date DATE NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('draft','sent','paid','overdue','cancelled') DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  subtotal DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  tax_amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL,
  discount_amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'OMR' NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  items JSON,
  created_by INT NOT NULL,
  created_by_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX office_id_idx (office_id),
  INDEX client_id_idx (client_id),
  INDEX status_idx (status),
  INDEX issue_date_idx (issue_date),
  INDEX due_date_idx (due_date)
)
